correctness.rationale: Faces are ALL edge sets of K7 of maximum graph degree <=2; triangles are allowed. Independent incremental degree-mask enumeration obtained 15,795 nonempty faces, f-vector (21,210,1190,3780,6132,3997,465). Complete lexicographic toggle matching yields 7,675 disjoint pairs and one 0-cell, 132 4-cells, 312 5-cells, with all 77,007 nonempty Hasse covers acyclic by independent topological sorting. Independently computed the complete oriented 132x312 Morse boundary via unit-incidence gradient recursion and exact Smith normal form (sympy/ZZ); there are precisely 131 nonzero invariant factors, each 1. This leaves rank 1 H4 and rank 181 H5 and no integral torsion. Since the 4-skeleton is wedge 132 S4 and pi4 equals its integral H4, unimodular basis changes implement 131 degree-one attachments/cancellations, leaving S4 wedge 181 S5. This proves integral homotopy for the finite complex, not just modular Betti numbers.

Vega studies smaller graph families, while Limonchenko-Yu treat bipartite capacity complexes. Jonsson has highly relevant numerical bounded-degree homology tables, potentially including this entry; even previously tabulated Betti ranks alone do not imply the exact integral wedge homotopy type.
